items.title: Metabolic profiling of licensed mesenchymal stromal cells reveals a disconnect between glycolytic fitness and immunomodulatory responsiveness
items.finding: In umbilical cord and bone marrow MSCs, combined IFN-gamma plus TNF-alpha licensing raised glycolytic flux and respiratory capacity in most donors and partly improved post-thaw metabolism, but donors with better post-thaw metabolism did not consistently show stronger inflammatory biomarker responses.

items.title: Clinical manufacturing of adipose-derived stem cells for therapeutic use: current technologies, quality systems and production challenges
items.finding: Across 46 studies published January 2020 to September 2025, automated bioreactors gave 2 to 10 fold higher adipose MSC yields than flask culture, and reported GMP production costs ranged from $15,000 to $50,000 per dose.

items.title: Stress-Induced Senescence of Human Umbilical Cord Mesenchymal Stromal Cells Caused by Mitomycin C
items.source: Bulletin of Experimental Biology and Medicine
items.finding: Mitomycin C (1.5 ug/mL) caused DNA damage and complete proliferation arrest in umbilical cord MSCs through p53/p21/p27 without p16, with higher IL-8 and PAI-1, but without SA-beta-gal activity, oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction or lysosomal accumulation.

items.title: TGFB1-Engineered Induced Mesenchymal Stromal Cells Exhibit High Immunomodulatory Potency and Durably Reprogram Synovial Macrophages in Osteoarthritis
items.finding: A doxycycline-inducible, hTERT-immortalized iPSC-derived MSC line overexpressing TGFB1 matched or exceeded adipose MSC donors in a monocyte-macrophage immunomodulation assay and shifted synovial macrophages in a mouse osteoarthritis model, but did not reduce cartilage degeneration, synovitis or fibrosis.

items.title: Long-term monthly mesenchymal stromal cell therapy for advanced chronic lung allograft dysfunction: a single-centre safety and feasibility cohort study
items.finding: Six lung transplant patients with advanced, treatment-refractory chronic lung allograft dysfunction received 251 monthly IV infusions of allogeneic, HLA-unmatched bone marrow MSCs over up to 58 months with no infusion-related toxicity or serious treatment-related adverse events.

items.title: The human amniotic membrane derived MSC secretome restrains neuroinflammation and peripheral immune cell invasion of 3D neural tissue through conserved CXCL10 blockade and proteostatic rescue
items.finding: Conditioned medium from human amniotic membrane MSCs damped inflammatory and cell-death programs in human neural cell cultures and 3D neurospheroids, reduced CD4+ T-cell migration and splenocyte invasion of inflamed neural tissue, and CXCL10 suppression was the most consistent correlate across four model systems.

items.title: Cell-Free Wharton's Jelly-Derived MSC Secretome in a Polymeric Carrier for Refractory Chronic Wounds: Two Cases
items.finding: Two patients with year-plus refractory ulcers (a 95-year-old with peripheral arterial disease and a 69-year-old with a neuro-ischemic diabetic foot ulcer) reached complete closure at about 27 and 28 weeks using a cell-free Wharton's jelly MSC secretome in a thermoresponsive gel applied every three days alongside standard care.

items.title: Epithelial-endothelial barrier dysfunction and oxidative stress in ARDS subphenotypes: comparative efficacy of extracellular vesicles derived from bone marrow (MSC-EVs) and adipose tissue (ASC-EVs) mesenchymal stem cells
items.finding: Bone marrow and adipose MSC EVs both restored tight-junction proteins and redox balance in airway epithelial and endothelial cells injured by plasma from ARDS patients, with effects that varied by hyper- or hypoinflammatory subphenotype and by timing of dosing.

items.title: Characterization of Umbilical Cord Mesenchymal Stromal Cells Overexpressing Klotho and In Vitro Anti-Aging Efficacy of Their Derived Extracellular Vesicles
items.finding: Umbilical cord MSCs engineered to overexpress Klotho produced Klotho-enriched EVs that rescued senescent phenotypes in adult bone marrow MSCs and HK-2 renal tubular cells in vitro and restored the osteogenic capacity of adult bone marrow MSCs.

items.title: A metabolic-oxidative axis contributes to NK cell cryo-vulnerability
items.finding: Activated NK cells shifted to high glucose use and excess ROS and survived freeze-thaw poorly (about 25%), while pretreatment with glucose-metabolism inhibitors, antioxidants or lipid-peroxidation inhibitors restored post-thaw recovery to about 90% with preserved antitumor activity in mice.

items.title: The Histone Methyltransferase KMT2D promotes Natural Killer cell effector molecule release
items.finding: KMT2D mutations in two NK-deficiency patients impaired cytotoxicity, and KMT2D loss in human and mouse NK cells reduced degranulation and release of granzyme B and IFN-gamma through lower H3K4me1 and RAB3D, without lowering intracellular stores.

items.title: Clonal selection of somatic mutations shapes NK cell memory
items.finding: Somatic mutation tracing in a large cohort of healthy CMV-seropositive people showed strong clonal dominance among memory NK cells with evidence of positive selection, including loss-of-function KMT2D mutations, and Kmt2d deletion in mice altered NK fitness depending on timing and context.

items.title: A temporal threshold in TGF-beta signaling separates reversible tissue adaptation from persistent NK cell effector dysfunction
items.finding: Short TGF-beta exposure caused mostly reversible changes in human NK cells, but prolonged exposure locked in effector dysfunction through durable loss of chromatin accessibility at IRF, EOMES and T-bet motif sites, a state also seen in NK cells from hepatocellular carcinoma patients.

items.title: Natural Killer Cell-Derived Extracellular Vesicle Preparations Demonstrate Potent Antitumor Activity Against Human Glioblastoma In Vitro and In Vivo
items.finding: EVs from primary expanded human NK cells killed glioblastoma lines including NK-resistant ones, slowed subcutaneous and orthotopic tumors, and prolonged survival after IV dosing in mice.

items.title: Peripheral immune signatures predict cognitive decline in older adults: a population-based cohort study
items.finding: In 9,008 older adults from the Health and Retirement Study, higher CD56hi NK cells and naive B cells each independently predicted lower risk of cognitive impairment, and an immune risk score predicted incident cognitive impairment or dementia.

items.title: Mesenchymal Stem Cells Ameliorate Acute-on-Chronic Liver Failure Associated With Expansion of Immunoregulatory Hepatic NKp46+DX5- NK Cells
items.finding: In HBV-related acute-on-chronic liver failure patients, MSC infusion raised peripheral NK frequency in step with liver function recovery, and in mice MSCs rescued liver failure and selectively expanded hepatic NKp46+DX5- NK cells, promoting their proliferation and GM-CSF secretion in vitro.

items.title: A Deep-Learning Based Biomarker of Systemic Cellular Senescence Burden to Predict Mortality and Health Outcomes
items.finding: A deep-learning composite of blood SASP proteins built on UK Biobank proteomics independently predicted mortality and incident chronic disease, and its trajectory changed with multimodal exercise over 18 months in an independent randomized trial cohort.

items.title: The p53-p21-Cyclin D2 regulatory axis drives metabolic reprogramming and a distinct senescent macrophage senotype during aging and MASLD
items.finding: A p53-p21 program represses p16 in a p21-high senescent macrophage subtype, where Cyclin D2 moves to mitochondria and lipid droplets to drive metabolic reprogramming and sustain the SASP; these cells accumulate with aging and MASLD and can be selectively depleted by senolytic treatment.

items.title: Extracellular Vesicles From Senescent Cancer Cells Are Necessary and Sufficient to Drive Paracrine Senescence
items.finding: EVs from bleomycin-induced senescent A549 cancer cells were necessary and sufficient to spread senescence to neighboring tumor cells, and blocking EV biogenesis with GW4869 or RAB27A knockdown blunted paracrine senescence without changing soluble SASP secretion.
